{{Top|leg}}
'''Pouch-mothers''' were surrogate [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] who nourished the Huttlets of other females in their [[Brood pouch/Legends|brood pouchs]]. They worked at the [[communal nursery]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] where Hutt mothers could send their Huttlets for a few [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] each [[Standard day/Legends|day]] so they could focus on their occupational duties. Hutts generally had a close relationship with their pouch-mother as well as their actual parent.<ref name="MedStar I: Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>
